outcome: Relationship of adhesions to clinical scenario
Relationship of adhesions to type of previous surgery
Conversion of laparoscopy to open surgery due to adhesions
cohort: 654 women who underwent gynecological laparoscopic surgery for various indications, including secondary infertility, adnexal lesions, and primary infertility
finding: Adhesions were prevalent in gynecological patients with previous abdominopelvic surgery, particularly those who had open surgery or cesarean sections, and were significantly associated with gynecological and reproductive issues.
mod_finding: Cesarean sections were significantly associated with adhesions, with patients who had cesarean sections being more likely to have adhesions than those who had not.
